company.name: Casper (Casper Sleep Inc.)
company.what_they_do: Casper designs and sells mattresses, pillows, bedding, furniture and other sleep products. Its mattresses are made by Carpenter Co, the foam manufacturer Casper belongs to.
company.customers: Consumers in the United States and Canada who are buying mattresses and bedding for their homes.
company.how_they_sell: Sales happen mainly through online checkout on casper.com. A quiz helps buyers choose a product, and financing is offered through Affirm and Katapault. Sleep specialists take phone calls and chats, and there is a contact form and email. Casper also has its own stores and partner stores. Delivery runs through UPS, and in-home setup through RXO. LoadUp handles mattress removal. Returns are covered by a 100-night trial.
company.size_hints: More than 110,000 five-star reviews. Stores in cities across the United States and Canada, plus partner stores. More than 12 years in the business. Part of the Carpenter Co family. The jobs page lists both corporate and retail positions.

audit.headline: The first thing worth automating at Casper is starting returns online, because mattress and furniture returns now need a phone call and smaller items need an email, so every 100-night trial return goes through a support agent.
audit.caveat: The website shows customer-facing policies but nothing about the support tools, contact volumes or partner contracts that Casper and Carpenter Co already have, so some of these gaps may already be handled behind the scenes.

signals.observation: Mattress and furniture returns cannot be started online. Customers have to phone the support line.
signals.quote: For larger items like mattresses or furniture, please contact us at +1 888-498-0003

signals.observation: Returns for toppers, Glows and dog beds start with an email to the customer experience team.
signals.quote: If this product isn't right for you or your pup, email our Customer Experience team here for assistance.

signals.observation: To get a return label, customers either contact support or dig up the original confirmation email.
signals.quote: Contact us or click the order number in your original order confirmation email, to view and print your shipping label.

signals.observation: Refunds can take up to two weeks to show up. That delay likely leads to follow-up questions from customers.
signals.quote: Refunds will be credited back to your account within two weeks.

signals.observation: Live support only works set hours. A virtual assistant covers nights and evenings.
signals.quote: Our virtual assistant is available from 9pm-9am Monday - Friday and 6pm-9am Saturday/Sunday.

signals.observation: In-home delivery depends on customers answering two phone calls and confirming out loud. Missed calls put deliveries at risk.
signals.quote: You must answer both calls and confirm verbally to accept the delivery.

signals.observation: Removal is booked through a separate partner email. If the customer does not reply on the day, the appointment may be rescheduled.
signals.quote: LoadUp will send you an email (separate from your Casper order confirmation) with a link to schedule your appointment.

signals.observation: Order tracking depends on customers finding their shipping email or logging in. This is a common source of 'where is my order' contacts.
signals.quote: To track your package, simply locate your shipping confirmation email and click on the tracking number.

signals.observation: Comparison prices are checked by hand through market research every quarter.
signals.quote: Our team conducts thorough market research every quarter to ensure our comparable value is always accurate to the bedding market

signals.observation: Shipping cannot be sped up, so customers who need a bed faster are sent to a store.
signals.quote: Since we cannot expedite orders, your best bet would be to visit one of our stores.

signals.observation: General questions come in through a free-text contact form. Someone has to read and sort each message by hand.
signals.quote: Fill out the form with your personal information and send us a

signals.observation: Whether a mattress can be removed is decided on site by the delivery crew, using rules that are checked by hand.
signals.quote: All mattresses removed using Casper’s In-Home Delivery and Setup service must be in sanitary condition, to be determined by the on-site delivery team

opportunities.title: Online return requests for every product
opportunities.problem: Mattress and furniture returns can only be started by calling the support line, and toppers, Glows and dog beds start with an email. To get a return label, customers have to contact support or find the original confirmation email, so each return takes agent time.
opportunities.approach: Add a return request form to the account and help pages. It looks up the order, asks for the reason and routes the request by product type. Small items get a printable label right away. Mattress and furniture requests create a ticket with pickup details already filled in, and the customer gets status emails until the refund is issued.

measure.metric: Share of returns started without a phone call or email to an agent
measure.baseline: In week 1, count return requests by channel (phone, email, form) and product type from the phone and ticket systems. Also record the time from first contact to label sent or pickup booked.
measure.target: Move at least half of return starts to the online form, and cut time to label for small items to a few minutes

opportunities.days_30: Return volume by channel and product measured, and form flow agreed with the customer experience lead.
opportunities.days_60: Form live for toppers, Glows, dog beds and pillows, with instant labels.
opportunities.days_90: Mattress and furniture requests on the form, with status emails until refund.
opportunities.assumption: The plan assumes the phone step for mattress returns is a gap, when it may be a deliberate retention step where agents offer exchanges, comfort layers or partial refunds to save the sale.
opportunities.ask: When a customer calls to return a mattress, what share end up keeping it, exchanging it or taking a partial refund, and does that save rate depend on talking to an agent?

opportunities.title: Proactive order tracking and refund status messages
opportunities.problem: To track an order, customers have to find their shipping email or log in, and the notes flag this as a common source of where-is-my-order contacts. Refunds can take up to two weeks to show up, which likely brings more follow-up questions, some of them outside live support hours.
opportunities.approach: Send text and email updates from order system data at key events: shipped, delayed, out for delivery, delivered, return received and refund issued. Add order lookup by email and order number to live chat and the virtual assistant so it can answer status questions at any hour.

measure.metric: Order status and refund status contacts per 100 orders
measure.baseline: Tag a week of chats, calls and emails by contact reason, then count status questions against order volume for the same week.
measure.target: Cut status contacts per 100 orders by about a third

opportunities.days_30: Contact reasons tagged and baseline per 100 orders set.
opportunities.days_60: Shipped, delayed and refund issued messages live for all orders.
opportunities.days_90: Order lookup live in chat and the virtual assistant, with results compared to baseline.
opportunities.assumption: The plan assumes status questions are a large share of contacts and that the virtual assistant cannot already look up orders, but the website does not show contact volumes or what the assistant can do.
opportunities.ask: What share of chats, calls and emails are about order status or refund status, and can your virtual assistant look up a specific order today?

opportunities.title: Reminders for in-home delivery and removal booking
opportunities.problem: For in-home delivery, the customer has to answer two calls from RXO and confirm out loud. LoadUp removal is booked through a separate email, and the appointment may be rescheduled if the customer does not reply on the day. Missed calls and unread partner emails put deliveries at risk and lead to repeat trips.
opportunities.approach: Send Casper-branded texts and emails that tell customers to expect the RXO calls and the LoadUp email, with the scheduling links included. Flag orders that are still unbooked after a set number of days so an agent can reach out before delivery day.

measure.metric: Share of in-home deliveries and removals that get rescheduled or fail
measure.baseline: In week 1, ask RXO and LoadUp for outcome data on recent orders and count reschedules and failed attempts per order.
measure.target: Cut reschedules and failed attempts by about a quarter

opportunities.days_30: Partner outcome data in hand and failure points mapped.
opportunities.days_60: Reminders before the delivery calls and for removal booking are live.
opportunities.days_90: Alerts for unbooked orders working, and reschedule rate compared to baseline.
opportunities.assumption: The plan assumes missed RXO calls and unanswered LoadUp emails cause enough failed or rescheduled deliveries to matter, and that Casper can get outcome data from both partners.
opportunities.ask: How many in-home deliveries or removals were rescheduled or failed last quarter because the customer missed a call or did not book through the partner link?

dropped.title: Sorting and first replies for the contact form
dropped.reason: The plan assumes the contact form gets enough volume and is sorted by hand, when most help desks already offer basic tagging and many customers likely use chat or phone instead.

dropped.title: Automated price checks for comparison values
dropped.reason: The plan assumes the quarterly price review takes real analyst time, when the website line may describe a legal or pricing team task that is small and needs human judgment about which products count as comparable.

questions: When a customer calls to return a mattress, what share end up keeping it, exchanging it or taking a partial refund, and does that save rate depend on talking to an agent?
What share of chats, calls and emails are about order status or refund status, and can your virtual assistant look up a specific order today?
How many in-home deliveries or removals were rescheduled or failed last quarter because the customer missed a call or did not book through the partner link?
What are the top five reasons customers contact you, and roughly how many contacts per week does each one bring in?
Which help desk, order system and phone system do you use, and can they share data with each other and with RXO, LoadUp and UPS?
Since joining Carpenter Co, which customer support and logistics decisions are made by Casper and which are set by the parent company?

Which mattress size is right for you?
When picking your next mattress, it’s more than just personal preference—two key things to keep in mind are how much room you have and who’s sleeping in the bed.
Upgrading to a King mattress is a game-changer if you’re sharing space with kids or pets. And if you’re tall, the extra length of a California King could be just right.
A Full size mattress is ideal for young adults or those with a smaller bedroom, while a Queen is the top pick for couples or anyone who enjoys extra space to sprawl out.
The Twin is the smallest option, ideal for single sleepers. While the Twin XL is a dorm favorite it can also create a Split King if you purchase two.
Which pillow size is right for you?
Pillow sizes can vary, but standard pillows, also known as queen pillows, are typically suitable for all types of sleepers. If you prefer extra space or need to fill the width of a larger mattress, king-size pillows, which are about 30% larger, are a great choice.

UPS Standard Ground Shipping
In stock products are typically delivered within 2-8 business days after order.
Casper mattress boxes are about the size of a mini-fridge and can weigh anywhere from 47-139 lbs depending on the mattress model and size. Teamwork makes the dream work — unboxing is easiest when you have a helping hand.
As soon as it’s available, we’ll send UPS tracking information via email for each item in your order. During checkout, you can opt-in to receive text message updates or add a signature requirement for your delivery. When you sign up for UPS My Choice®, you can keep a closer eye on your shipments, modify your shipping preferences, or schedule a future delivery date.
Processing Time
Order processing typically takes 1-3 business days.
Please keep in mind that delivery may take longer during/after holidays or severe weather conditions.
Due to changes in product availability, sometimes there will be “ships by” messaging on our site.
The product is set to ship by the date provided, at the latest, which means it can ship any day before.
While these orders have a slightly longer processing time, the travel time via UPS is still a standard 1-5 business days.
Shipping Fees
Shipping via UPS is free for mattresses, soft goods, and accessories within the contiguous United States.
We are unable to ship to APO and PO Boxes, or US Territories like Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands.
Let us do the heavy lifting for $249.
In Home Delivery and Setup Service + Optional Mattress Removal
How does In-Home Delivery and Setup Work?
When you purchase products to be delivered via our in-home delivery and set up partners at RXO, it typically takes 2-4 weeks for items to be delivered to your home. If your order includes soft goods like sheets and pillows, those items will be delivered directly to your door via UPS, while the mattress and furniture will be sent to our delivery partners. RXO will work with you to schedule a delivery date and removal if you opted into product removal at the time of purchase.
1.) After you have placed an order with In-Home Delivery and Setup, our partner RXO Logistics will send you an order confirmation (separate from your Casper order confirmation) with a scheduling link. Once your product(s) arrive at RXO's location, the scheduling link will update, and RXO's automated phone system will call and provide you with the next available date for delivery. You’ll also be able to talk to an RXO Scheduling agent.
2.) The day before your delivery date, you'll receive a call that confirms a four-hour delivery window in which your delivery team will arrive. During that four-hour window, they will call again within 30 minutes of their arrival. ​​You must answer both calls and confirm verbally to accept the delivery.
3.)The delivery team will bring your In-Home Delivery eligible Casper products to the appropriate room, set them up, and remove any packaging materials.
4.) You can also add a removal service to remove and recycle your previously owned mattress and foundation/box spring. To be eligible for the removal of a mattress and box spring, those items must be purchased through Casper. An order with one mattress will be eligible for the removal of one used mattress. An order with one foundation will be eligible for the removal of one used box spring/foundation.
All mattresses removed using Casper’s In-Home Delivery and Setup service must be in sanitary condition, to be determined by the on-site delivery team, and all box springs must be able to be removed without being broken down.
Please note that our delivery partner does not remove bed frames. In addition, our partners are limited to arranging and setting up Casper products only.
LoadUp: Mattress Removal Service
Casper partners with LoadUp, a national logistics and recycling company, to remove your old mattress and furniture. This optional service is available in eligible areas (excluding California) for $150 and can be selected at checkout.
) LoadUp will send you an email (separate from your Casper order confirmation) with a link to schedule your appointment.
) Scheduling is typically available as soon as the next day, up to 28 days in advance – appointments are scheduled in four-hour time slots.
) On the day of your appointment, you'll receive a text message or phone call when the LoadUp team is on the way. You must respond to this text or call to confirm. If you're unable to respond, your appointment may be rescheduled.
) Items are removed on a one-for-one basis, matching each eligible Casper product purchased. For example, if you purchased a Casper mattress and bedframe, LoadUp can only remove one mattress and one bed frame.
LoadUp provides removal services only and does not perform assembly or setup, so if you are interested in set-up services, check out In-Home Delivery & Setup option!
LoadUp can remove a maximum of three eligible items per appointment. If you need more than three items removed, consider our In-Home Delivery & Setup service.
LoadUp can remove mattresses, bed frames and adjustable bases, but cannot remove the Repose, or Haven bedframe or other non-eligible household items.
Frequently asked questions
Can you expedite shipping?
All Casper products ship via UPS Standard Shipping which typically takes 2-8 business days. Since we cannot expedite orders, your best bet would be to visit one of our stores. Click here to use our Store Locator to find the Casper Sleep Shop or partner store nearest you!
Do you deliver on Saturday or Sunday?
UPS will occasionally deliver ground packages on Saturdays. In order to get your order on Saturday or Sunday, we recommend having your packages delivered to a UPS store or friend's house ahead of the weekend, where you can pick up your packages at your own convenience.
Can I specify a delivery date?

pages.text:
Casper Return Center
Remember, it can take the body at least 30 days to adjust to a new mattress.
We give you 100 nights to try your mattress for free. Returns are free and easy anytime after the 30-Night Adjustment Period. See our expert tips for getting there faster.
Learn more
Pillows and Bedding Returns
You can return your Casper item and get a full refund within 30 days of delivery or within 30 days of an in-store purchase, provided the merchandise is unused, and in its original packaging and condition.
Print Shipping Labels
Contact us or click the order number in your original order confirmation email, to view and print your shipping label.
Prepare your package
Attach the return label to the outside of the box. If you don't have the original packaging, any sturdy box will do.
Ship it at no cost
Drop your return package off at any UPS location. Sit back and relax.
Furniture Returns
It’s important to test out all your Casper products in your own sleep environment. We offer a 30-night trial on our furniture products so that you can do just that. When you purchase your furniture with a paired mattress, we're happy to extend the trial to 100 nights to match that of your mattress. As long as your furniture is in donate-able condition, you can return it without the original packaging or box, even if it has been assembled.
Glow, Mattress Topper, and Dog Bed Returns
Our Glows, Mattress Toppers, and Dog Bed all come with 30-night trials. If this product isn't right for you or your pup, email our Customer Experience team here for assistance.
Bundle Returns
When you purchase a Casper Bundle, all of the items in the bundle will have the same trial period. If your bundle includes a mattress, the entire bundle will have a 100-night trial period.
Refunds
Refunds will be credited back to your account within two weeks.
If you paid for shipping to Hawaii or Alaska, you’ll get a refund for those shipping costs as well.
If you paid for our in-home delivery and setup service, we will not refund for the service performed.
You may return a maximum of two items of the same product type.
For more information on our return policy, see Terms .
